title: Nifty slips 0.44% to 22,622 as wholesale inflation jumps to 11.39%; IT and FMCG hold firm
short: Nifty slips to 22,622 as wholesale inflation jumps to 11.39%
dek: Profit-taking after Tuesday's rally, a hot WPI print and Brent near $106 pulled the Sensex down 252 points. IT, FMCG and the rupee held up.
card: Sensex −252 at 72,781.89, Nifty −99 at 22,622.70. Pharma and financials fell; IT and FMCG rose; the rupee gained again.
